snippet.title: DIRE ECHO — Official Announcement Trailer | Space Horror Game
snippet.description:
Prepare to enter the void.

Set in the near future, DIRE ECHO is a psychological space horror experience where isolation becomes your only companion. You are an astronaut sent on a routine mission — but when the silent research vessel Echo-7 enters your path, routine turns into a nightmare.

🛰️ Investigate the mysterious silence
👁️‍🗨️ Explore abandoned corridors
📡 Uncover what happened to the crew
🔦 Experience realistic graphics and immersive sound
🧠 Psychological tension in deep space

No crew. No answers. Only echoes remain.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743180/Dire_Echo/
Follow me on Twitter: https://x.com/TrueGamesStudio
